sentences.text:
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 4521 of 2024
Applicant :- Bebi Singh

Opposite Party :- State Of Up And 4 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Sheo Kinkar Singh,Suryaprakash Sharma

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mayank Kumar Jain,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused material on
record.

2. This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking direction to the trial court for
early decision of Case No.498 of 2018, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 494 I.P.C., P.S.
Pashchim Sharira, District Kaushambi within some stipulated period.
3.  It is submitted by learned counsel for the appellant that applicant has filed the aforesaid case in the year 2018 but the trail court has not decided the case till date.

4. Considering the fact that the trial has remained pending since 2018, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this application is finally disposed of with a direction to the court concerned to decide the aforesaid case in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible, without granting any unnecessary or long adjournments to either of the parties, expeditiously from the date of production of a certified copy of this order before it, if there is no other legal impediment.
